The player takes part in a mission to Mars that involves a fictional collision with a UFO, forcing an emergency landing. details:
MARS: SURVIVAL MISSION is an interactive educational video game aimed at children aged 7 to 12, combining space exploration, survival, and mystery. The player experiences a mission to Mars that—following a fictional collision with a UFO—results in an emergency landing. To survive, the player must manage oxygen and food supplies, protect themselves from radiation, and explore the Martian environment, all while facing challenges inspired by real-world scientific conditions.

The project offers a dynamic learning experience that helps players understand the risks of space exploration through decision-making, challenges, and interactive activities. Its intended impact is to foster scientific curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and an interest in STEM fields, bringing space research closer to new generations.

The project’s creativity lies in its blend of scientific data from NASA with a fictional, extraterrestrial mystery narrative, transforming learning into an immersive adventure. The development team takes into account the target age group, accessibility, scientific accuracy, content safety, progressive difficulty, and educational value.

The development tools and technologies will be selected based on the requirements of the prototype, prioritizing an accessible interactive platform, engaging visual assets, and mechanics that are intuitive for children.
